Plattkofel, also known as Sasso Piatto in Italian, is a mountain located in the Dolomites mountain range in South Tyrol, Italy. It is part of the Sassolungo mountain group and is situated in the Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol region. The mountain has an elevation of approximately 3,056 meters (10,026 feet) above sea level and is a popular destination for mountaineering, hiking, and rock climbing.

The area around Plattkofel is known for its scenic beauty and is located near the famous Val Gardena (Gröden) valley. It is a part of the Dolomites UNESCO World Heritage Site, which was recognized for its unique geological and scenic characteristics.
